latent_cache.generation: existing Phase 2 goal/tracking_inference on independent reference environments; verified cache loaded without re-encoding

reference_preprocessing.orientation: source world frame, no yaw offset
reference_preprocessing.alignment_freeze: original frame for full episode; no per-step realignment

entry_conditions.evaluation_mode: permits unvalidated candidate only; does not bypass invariant or transition entry checks
entry_conditions.stand_to_track: fresh current STAND-region predicates AND no invariants
entry_conditions.unknown_bootstrap: episode start only, initial physical checks pass
entry_conditions.motion_first_frame: measure mismatch; no extra gate in V1

budget.stop_rule: stop before next episode if either budget reached; mark remaining NOT_RUN; individual failures do not stop subsequent planned episodes

statistics.denominator: requested and actually started reported separately
statistics.fixed_grid: count per sampled scenario, no population probability
statistics.random_mixture: success/started plus 95% Wilson interval only for stated mixture
statistics.completion: Phase 2 legacy reference consumed and terminal stabilization
statistics.tracking_quality: diagnostic joint/root/FK body metrics; no quality acceptance threshold
statistics.negative_control: same request/timing but stand latent; never capability evidence
